one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-03 to 2026-11-01. AAOI's Q3 2026 print is very likely outside it: no date 8-K is on EDGAR as of 2026-10-03 (latest filing 2026-09-17) and the last two Q3 8-K 2.02 filings came 2025-11-06 and 2024-11-07, so I now put ~7.5% (was 15-20%) on results or a pre-announcement inside the window. What is inside: hyperscaler Q3 calls and 2027 capex commentary (~Oct 27-30), which move the whole AI-optics group; late-October peer prints (Celestica, Corning; possibly Lumentum/Coherent/Fabrinet at the edge); steady supply from the $600M ATM (424B5, 2026-08-21), a mild headwind; and possible 1.6T qualification/shipment news ahead of the >$70M of Q4 1.6T revenue management guided. Short interest ~15% and a stock already ~50% off its June high cut both ways. No directional edge, so a lognormal centred slightly below spot (median ~$114 for ATM supply) with monthly sigma ~0.37 (139%/3.5 = 0.40, trimmed because no own-earnings print is likely). P(>= spot) = 0.485.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E on my NTM EPS as of Oct 2027 ($4.08 after a 10% execution haircut x 20x + ~$1.5 net cash = $83, weight 0.55), EV/EBITDA (NTM EBITDA ~$0.61B x 14x + $0.15B net cash over 99M shares = $88, weight 0.25) and a 5-year DCF (WACC 12.5%, g 4%, mature FCF margin 13% = $58, weight 0.20). Blended ~$79, down from $94 in round 1.

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 20x NTM-at-horizon EPS (mostly CY28), inside the range and below all three medians (35.3x / 26.0x / 21.6x on CY27). comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The discount to the module-maker median is structural and should persist through Oct 2027: (1) gross margin ~30% (Q2 29.8%, Q3 guide 29-30.5%, CEO's hedged Q4 32-33%) vs 41-51% at Innolight, Eoptolink, COHR and LITE, with no path to that level inside the horizon; (2) top-3 customers 92% of Q2 revenue (top-10 99%) and Digicomm 67% of receivables (10-Q); (3) no operating profit yet: Q2 Adjusted EBITDA -$0.5M, the non-GAAP profit coming from a $14.3M tax add-back; (4) negative FCF funded by repeated equity issuance (three raises in 2026, live $600M ATM), so per-share value leaks. I do not price AAOI with the EMS peers FN/CLS (12% GM but diversified customers, positive FCF, ~20-23x) or the Chinese pure plays (10.9-12.2x, which carry a geopolitical/China-listing discount and peak-cycle skepticism despite far higher margins). US/Texas manufacturing is a real but unproven offset, so it is not counted as a premium. I disagree with the supervisor only on the reference median: a full 10-12-peer set on a consistent CY27 basis gives 26-35x, not 21x; the 21x figure holds only for the 6 closest names. My 20x sits below either, so the conclusion is the same.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$55 (market cap ~$5.4B on ~99M diluted shares, ~12x the $4.60 FY27 consensus and ~13x my haircut NTM EPS) the market would be pricing FY27 EPS near $2-2.5: a failed or late 1.6T ramp, a cut at one of the three customers that make up 92% of revenue, or GM stuck below ~29% so the capex cannot earn a return. It sits well below the 2026 drawdown lows ($76 in July, ~$94 in September), so 139%-vol noise is unlikely to reach it without a fundamental break. I keep $55 rather than the supervisor's $60: the difference is within noise, and $55 is closer to my bear-case value.

reasoning: Round 2. I re-read the primary documents on the points the supervisor raised and accept most of them. (1) The Q2 8-K reconciliation confirms the $0.06 non-GAAP EPS includes a $14.3M ($0.18) tax add-back and Adjusted EBITDA was -$0.5M, so operating leverage has not started; I rebuilt opex from the call's $70-80M/quarter non-GAAP guide (Q2 ~$68M) to ~$400M/yr at scale, versus ~$320M before. (2) The release says ~650k units/month by YE2026; the call recap gives 930k for end-2027, so my ramp was a year early and NTM revenue at Oct 2027 drops from $3.0B to $2.9B. (3) FY27 consensus is $4.60 EPS / $2.66B revenue (StockAnalysis, 2026-08-19); I dropped the unverified Tickflow $5.73. (4) I re-read the transcript: the CEO's Q4 'I don't know, 32, 33%' GM comment is real but hedged, so I keep it at the low end (32%, from 33%). (5) No Q3 date 8-K on EDGAR, and prior Q3 prints came Nov 6/7, so the in-window print odds fall to ~7.5%. (6) Comps: I rebuilt an 11-peer set on one CY2027 basis from the StockAnalysis forecast pages. The median is 35.3x, the 8 module makers 26.0x and the 6 closest 21.6x; I dropped the fabless semis and systems names (MRVL, CRDO, AVGO, CIEN, ANET, GLW). Valuation: NTM EPS $4.53, $4.08 after the haircut, x 20x + net cash = $83 (P/E, 0.55); EV/EBITDA $88 (0.25); DCF $58 (0.20); blended ~$79 (was $94). Scenarios: bear $45 (0.28), base $100 (0.48), bull $195 (0.24), mean ~$107. The ladder is a mixture of lognormals (sigma ~0.50/0.33/0.36), shifted down about 3-4 points in the middle from round 1. I am below the supervisor's 0.45 at spot because my fair value is lower, but not as low as the fundamentals alone would put it: the module-maker multiples (26-35x CY27) show the market keeps paying for AI-optics growth, and the right tail is fat if Q4 confirms the step-up. P(>= $116) = 0.395. Research was limited to ~8 follow-up fetches/searches; peer EV/EBITDA is trailing only.
